Feedforward 0.50 for y=0.6 centers output so PI only trims residual; power-law 0.3 exponent reuses the 0.1->0.3 and 0.6->0.5 points for other targets. Integral enabled only |e|<0.25 and frozen on saturation with +/-0.35 authority to kill ff error without windup during initial rise from 0. 1s measurement filter suppresses +/-0.01 noise. High-y backoff caps prevent ever approaching 0.9.
